description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the ExamResult page in an online examination system. It manages session data, retrieves and updates user examination results from a SQL database, and prepares data for display on the results page.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET page handling exam result display and related database updates.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event; retrieves session data, updates database with new exam results, and populates UI controls.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and redirects to the login page.
